mapper.select: SELECT f.friend_relation_id AS FriendRelationId, u.user_icon AS userIcon, u.user_nickname AS userNickname FROM friends f JOIN users u ON u.user_id = CASE WHEN f.requester_id = #{userId} THEN f.receiver_id ELSE f.requester_id END WHERE f.friend_status = 1 AND (f.requester_id = #{userId} OR f.receiver_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY f.friend_relation_id DESC
